next.pattern: Second and fourth Tuesday of each month at 7:00 p.m., Council Chambers, 2nd floor of City Hall, 776 NE 125 Street. Summer recess mid-July to late August and winter recess mid-December to late January. Streamed on NoMi TV, YouTube and the CHAMP agenda site.

levers.how: Attend the meeting and speak; meeting notices say interested members of the public are invited to attend and participate. For quasi-judicial items, fill out a speaker card (in favor or against) and hand it to the City Clerk before the comment period for that item.
levers.rules: Speaker card: comments no more than 2 minutes, speakers called in the order the Mayor sets, address the Council as a whole, no questions to individual members, and state whether you are a registered lobbyist. Lobbyists must register with the City Clerk before addressing the Council. No general time limit or sign-up rule for non-quasi-judicial comment is posted.
levers.deadline: Submit the speaker card before the item's comment period

levers.how: No written comment procedure is posted. Email the City Clerk's office, which also sends agenda copies on request.
Call or visit the Mayor and Council Office, 2nd floor of City Hall, weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
